summary: The diff implements an “Explore by Style” badge carousel component (in the existing ShopByStyleBlock file) and adds SPA navigation to a new /collections/:slug destination page (StyleCollectionsPage) wired into App.tsx. However, the diff summary does not show the required generated icon assets being added, does not show the home-page placement above the CinematicHeroSlider, and appears to use theme tokens/OKLCH colors rather than the exact hex palette specified (#D4AF37, #7FB3D5).

missing_requirements.requirement: Home page ("/") renders a new top-of-home section above the existing CinematicHeroSlider with a centered serif heading "Explore by Style" in gold accent and a horizontally scrollable single-row badge carousel.
missing_requirements.reason: While the Explore-by-Style UI is implemented in ShopByStyleBlock, the diff does not show any change in the home page composition (e.g., HomeSection) to place it above the CinematicHeroSlider. No evidence in the provided modified files indicates where/that it is inserted at the top of home.

missing_requirements.requirement: Preserve the specified palette with pearl blue #7FB3D5 and gold #D4AF37 without altering global theme tokens unexpectedly.
missing_requirements.reason: The implementation uses CSS variables defined in OKLCH (e.g., --gold, --pearl-blue) rather than the explicitly required hex colors, so the diff does not demonstrate compliance with the exact palette values.

missing_requirements.requirement: Add 5 generated circular icon images under frontend/public/assets/generated and reference them via static paths in the badges.
missing_requirements.reason: ShopByStyleBlock references the expected static paths under /assets/generated, but the diff summary does not show any added image files under frontend/public/assets/generated (only one new TSX file is listed as added).

hallucinated_features.description: New collections route handling for /collections/:slug in App.tsx (manual regex-based route match) instead of only updating the home section.
hallucinated_features.reason: REQ-23 asks for a safe real route pattern and meaningful destination; this is within scope, but it goes beyond just "replace home-top block" by adding new top-level routing logic in App.tsx.
